title: Vehicle details are not updated after edit
description: After editing a vehicle and clicking Save, the updated details are not displayed until the page is refreshed.

title: Network error message is not displayed
description: When the API request fails due to connectivity issues, the user receives no feedback and the page appears frozen.

title: Incorrect mileage validation
description: The system accepts negative mileage values when editing an existing vehicle.

title: Vehicle details page crashes on refresh
description: Refreshing the vehicle details page results in a blank screen due to an undefined route parameter.

title: Cannot save a new car record
description: When creating a new car and clicking Save, the form remains in loading state and the record is not persisted.
